checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: merge drones, escorts, mercenaries and alliances behind one fleet report/action and CLI verb

impact_assessment.why: One FLEET cockpit tab is backed by three CLI commands and fifteen routes; the roster, upkeep and alliance state are assembled separately.
impact_assessment.benefits: One report with drones, mercenary units, escorts, offers, alliances, catalogs and counts; one action route; one fleet CLI verb with overview/mercs/allies/hire/dismiss/refit/ally.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REST/CLI/snapshot; dependency: fleet/frontier catalogs; concurrency: report reads under lock, actions delegate; state: no save change; regression: legacy fleet/mercs/allies commands and routes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: 11 facade tests, full 1370 suite, gate, and the existing FLEET tab left intact.

[1/1] Plan: hide 21 legacy merged verbs from CLI help and usage while keeping them callable

impact_assessment.why: Five facade merges added preferred verbs, but the legacy aliases remained visible, so the CLI help grew to 75 entries.
impact_assessment.benefits: The visible help lists the five facades; legacy invocations still parse; no API change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI help only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; regression: hidden verbs must still execute and tests must stay green.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Full 1389 suite, targeted hidden-verb invocation, gate.

checkpoints.description: Help consolidation verified: 21 legacy verbs hidden from help/usage, hidden verbs still execute, 1389 suite; checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-cli-help-consolidation' completed successfully.

[1/1] Plan: merge crew, stations, shore leave and away teams behind one crew report/action and CLI verb
